description: Central Government scheme providing recognition, skill development, toolkit support, collateral-free credit and marketing support to eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople working in specified trades.
target_beneficiaries: Self-employed workers in notified traditional trades
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card
Collateral-free enterprise development loans up to Rs 3 lakh in eligible stages
documents_required: Occupation or trade verification as required
how_to_apply: Apply through an authorised Common Service Centre or the official PM Vishwakarma registration system.

description: Central Government credit support scheme for eligible street vendors to help support and expand their livelihood and business activities.
benefits: Access to UPI-linked credit facilities for eligible beneficiaries
documents_required: Vendor certificate or other local-body documentation where applicable
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks, financial institutions or the authorised PM SVANidhi application process.

description: Credit-linked subsidy programme intended to support new micro-enterprises and generate self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.
benefits: Support for establishing eligible new micro-enterprises
Credit-linked subsidy assistance subject to scheme rules
how_to_apply: Apply through the official PMEGP portal and complete the required application, project and bank procedures.

description: Central Government urban housing scheme for eligible families without a pucca house, covering defined income groups and different housing assistance components.
target_beneficiaries: Urban families without a pucca house
benefits: Housing assistance through applicable PMAY-U 2.0 components
Support for eligible construction or housing acquisition
Affordable housing and rental housing options under applicable components
documents_required: Property or land documents where applicable
Other documents required by the relevant PMAY-U 2.0 component
how_to_apply: Apply through the official PMAY-U 2.0 process or the relevant Urban Local Body or State implementing authority.
